intro: Durnan Furcutter is a dwarven clothier and leather merchant operating out of Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. Working inside Anvilmar, he equips freshly trained dwarven and gnomish adventurers with lightweight attire suited to withstand the biting mountain chills.

sections.t: A Warm Stitch in the Cold
p: Anvilmar serves as the first proving ground for young dwarves and exiled gnomes, and not every warrior steps forth clad in heavy iron. Durnan Furcutter caters to scouts, rogues, and spellcasters who need light, pliable layers to stay agile without succumbing to the bitter winds of Dun Morogh. Positioned right near the hearth of Anvilmar, he sells everyday tailoring and stitched leather, claiming his stock is the finest to be found in the entire valley.

Like any true dwarf stationed in the snowy foothills, Durnan appreciates a strong drink almost as much as an honest trade. He orders steaming mugs of Scalding Mornbrew from Nori Pridedrift, who sells the brew piping hot across Coldridge Valley, to fight off the freezing draft. Adventurers running errands in the valley often find themselves rushing a hot mug into his welcoming hands before it cools, then carrying the empty back to Nori.
